We need to mock static private methods? We could use reflection to set accessible? Actually we cannot mock private static directly with Mockito; we could use PowerMockito but not allowed. Instead we can verify behavior via side effects on DiscriminatorContext and JsonSchema mocks. The method probably checks if the parent schema (jsonSchema.getSchemaNode()) has a property with the same name as the mapping key. So we can set up the mock JsonSchema to have a schema node that returns appropriate boolean for has(key). In the earlier test they mocked parentSchemaNode.has("dog") to return false to make it true (since no override). So we can replicate.
